principle: Latent player value is not identified by one metric. R1 preserves observable indicators and claim ceilings instead of inventing a universal scalar fun score.

strategicAdaptation.interpretation: Whether usable information changes decisions in ways that improve modeled task performance.

meaningfulChoicePotential.interpretation: Whether context can causally alter available decisions without one path dominating the modeled population.

robustnessAcrossPlayerModels.interpretation: Whether a mechanism effect survives materially different modeled decision styles.

humanFeltAgency.interpretation: May be informed by future calibrated surrogates or external observations; never inferred directly from R1.

humanEnjoyment.interpretation: No mandatory Human gate follows from this unknown.

humanReplayDesire.interpretation: No mandatory Human gate follows from this unknown.

decisionRule: Computational indicators may support mechanism-search decisions inside their declared estimand. They do not inherit Human-specific semantics without calibration evidence.
